campaign.plan: Explicit specimen/fixture allocation may share preparation only for the same qualified geometry/mount; each measured route still completes its typed acquisition/reset body
campaign.completion: Complete source-matched campaign requires all nine physical configurations, all seven regression loads and three valid independent trials per case; changed/subset episodes must be labeled partial or authored departure

semantics.operation: Bound operation contract; physical robot operations require robot at their source station
semantics.transfer: Actual MOVE plus verified destination custody, never a label-only state change
semantics.repeat: Body repeated under unique trial IDs; no future observations precomputed
semantics.for_each: Enumerate every listed condition then return to parent scope
semantics.analysis_service: Electronic handoff only; does not change physical location
semantics.zero_mass: Skip actual weight transfer but verify zero active vector and capture a real image; no synthetic zero result
